suite_rule: Unless a scenario states otherwise, claims not named in expected_claim_states are CONFIRMED with valid independent evidence. Each scenario isolates the named failure.

scenarios.name: complete-independent-confirmation
given: Required evidence is current and integrity-verified

scenarios.name: no-alarm-but-stale-inspection
given: Physical condition observation expired before decision time

scenarios.name: three-position-records-one-gps-dependency
given: Vehicle GPS and drone GPS agree
Fused location derives from those GPS records
All three share failure domain gps-signal-01

scenarios.name: gps-plus-independent-landmark-position
given: The two records do not share a relevant positioning failure domain
scenarios.focus: Demonstrates C-04 reaching CONFIRMED via two genuinely independent lineages, not via the action-level reason code. A stateless evaluator cannot single out which of several confirmed claims is the scenario's narrative point - see claim_evaluations[C-04].reasons for the independence detail, and validation/2026-09-04_CODEX_FALSIFIER_REVIEW.md section 5 for why the action-level reason stays generic.

scenarios.name: structural-alarm-contradicts-visual-condition
given: Current authenticated structural sensor reports a critical condition

scenarios.name: stop-register-unavailable
given: Current authenticated stop register cannot be retrieved
No substitute positive confirmation is allowed

scenarios.name: permit-invalidated-by-stale-path-observation
scenarios.focus: A stateless current-state evaluator cannot distinguish first-time staleness from invalidation of a prior permit without a PermitRecord binding the exact prior contract version, evidence snapshot, and issue time (proposed, not yet built - see validation/2026-09-04_CODEX_FALSIFIER_REVIEW.md section 5). Until then this scenario mechanically tests C-03 staleness, same as S-02 tests C-02 staleness, and uses the same generic reason code.
